notes.title: Deep Horizon 1.11 Hotfix
notes.content:
Special thanks to @SgtFopper for bringing this one to our attention.

In our zeal to fix all kinds of pixel glitches in 1.1, we kind of broke the game in some fullscren resolutions.

The new build should address that, let us know how it goes!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29262710/43c8d19f7baf2ea715db73e1e9cac0ce1e9ec0f3.gif[/img]
